description:
Fast-food Taiwanese style consists of cheap and satisfying meals that are served double-time quick. Food entrepreneur Matt Chen is our guide to the best value-for-money food in the district of Banqiao, in New Taipei City.  

We sample everything from vegetarian chicken, to pork innards, to delicious MSG-free pork ball soup simmered for 16 hours at a mere US$0.60 a bowl! And of course, we can’t forget the ubiquitous bubble tea. 

WATCH MORE Lunch With Us: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkMf14VQEvTb6pxNMx7n5Ogn_wPC--sDo

0:00 Teaser & intro 
0:58 Ukuko Oyster Thin Noodles: Banqiao institution 
2:21 Oyster vermicelli with large intestines  
3:00 Why Taiwan’s vegetarian food is uniquely delicious 
4:16 Huan Nan Rice Noodles shop 
5:59 Braised pork rice is still only US$0.60! 
6:52 ‘Rat’ noodles, Mi Tai Mu 
7:09 Healthy high-protein meal: Hei Bai Qie 
8:08 Secret of boss’ handmade porkball soup (MSG-free)  
8:56 Why boss hasn’t raised prices in 10 years 
10:21 Kung Fu Tea: Red bean jelly cake milk tea 

========
About the series: Millions of working Asians must decide every day where to go for lunch – what’s quick, cheap, but also delicious? We join a motley variety of lunch companions at their favourite hangouts – and much more.
